verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੨ : ਦੋ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਮਹਿਮਾ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 2 : dho dhee ginatee gurmukh mahimaa

en.bdb: Counting to two, the glory of the Gurmukh,

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਨੋ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜ ਦਿਹੁਂ ਰਾਤਿ ਸਧਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: siv sakatee no saadh kai cha(n)dh sooraj dhihu(n) raat sadhaae|

en.bdb: Conquering Siva and S'akti (the rajas and tamas qualities), the gurmukhs have disciplined the moon-sun (ira, pingala) and also the time known by days and nights.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਾਧੇ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਾਪ ਲੰਘਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: sukh dhukh saadhe harakh sog narak surag pu(n)n paap la(n)ghaae|

en.bdb: Subjugating pleasure and pain, joy and suffering, they have gone beyond hell and heaven, sin and virtue.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਲਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰ੍ਰੁ ਨਿਵਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: janam maran jeevan mukat bhalaa buraa mitrr satrr nivaae|

en.bdb: They have humbled life, death, liberation in life, right and wrong, enemy and friend.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਜੋਗ ਜਿਣਿ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਰਹਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: raaj jog jin vas kar saadh sa(n)jog vijog rahaae|

en.bdb: Being victors of raj and yoga (temporality and spirituality), they have disciplined alliance  as well as separation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਨੀਂਦ ਭੂਖ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਜਿਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ।
verses.translit_en: vasagat keetee nee(n)dh bhookh aasaa manasaa jin ghar aae|

en.bdb: Conquering sleep, hunger, hope and desire, they have made their abode in their own true nature.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਸਤੁਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣ ਸਬਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: ausatut ni(n)dhaa saadh kai hi(n)dhoo musalamaan sabaae|

en.bdb: Going beyond praise and slander, they have become beloved of the Hindus as well as Muslims.
They bow before all and consider themselves as dust.
